fields.statement: QA with the head build (go build ./cmd/rhiza at 4610130) in a scratch git repo with origin/main, a change set, a CI stability record with TestPond flaking on 2 heads, and rhiza.ship.localGate set to a command that appends to a log: rhiza ship gate ran the gate once and wrote gated, gated_tree and gated_command to the ship state; the same head passed at once ('already passed on 4c0f0cb with the same code outside .rhiza/, so the gate was not run again'); a commit adding a .rhiza/ file and a .rhiza/log entry passed at once with the new head and that reason; a commit changing pkg/a.go ran it again; a dirty worktree ran it and recorded nothing (the next clean gate reused the previous record); a changed gate command ran it again on the same tree; a ship state with gated only (gated_tree and gated_command removed) ran it once, then reused.

QA with the head build in the same scratch repo, the gate echoing HEAD=$RHIZA_GATE_HEAD BASE=$RHIZA_GATE_BASE: rhiza ship gate --json output was HEAD=aa1864b... (git rev-parse HEAD) BASE=b8d5ae1... (git merge-base HEAD origin/main); after removing the origin remote and origin/main, output was HEAD=ae5ef44... BASE= (empty) and the gate still passed. The ship.gate summary in docs/reference/cli.md and describe-golden names both variables.

QA in a detached worktree of the branch head: make gate ARGS=-dry-run printed make test + make self-check for an empty RHIZA_GATE_BASE ('no base to scope by') and for the merge-base with origin/main ('Makefile changed'); make self-check only for base 8e79a27 (6 .rhiza/ files changed); after a probe commit to internal/textref, go test -trimpath for textref and its 13 transitive reverse dependencies, cmd/rhiza non-script tests and TestScripts limited to the leaf-named scripts under the test lock, then make self-check; after a probe change to ship-local-gate.txtar with RHIZA_CHANGE set, the -run pattern included ship-local-gate and describe-golden. A real make gate with base 8e79a27 ran make self-check only and exited 0 (with the run's RHIZA_ROOT unset; under it, self-check fails on the run's own unrendered actors, which is the run environment, not the change). go test -trimpath ./tools/gate passes; AGENTS.md:95 has the localGate 'make gate' line.
